title: 第89章 新战线第88章 魔器鬼域
content_zh:
石小军则趁着这次短暂的休息机会，准备给大地支柱完成最后一次化灵蜕变。
在地下深处寻宝数天，凑材料升级，但最后还是差两种材料找不到，他无奈的回到地面，找九叔去。
既然靠自己找不齐，那就只能到外面购买了。
龙界上有各种交易网站，线上线下都有，龙族自己建立的交易网站，就通常是线上直接交易的，可以快递送货。也有些私下的交易，在网上发布信息，然后线下交易，不过这些有不少是骗人的，容易上当受骗，损失钱财。
“小军，你的法器升级还缺什么材料？我看看龙族宝库里有没有这些材料，我们刚好有三次兑换权限。”
化灵材料需要的灵材品质很高，这些材料龙族即使有，也不会对外开放。
但石家军这次季度积分冠军，获得兑换宝库里顶级材料的权限，正好可以使用，不然就只能在黑市里求购了。
“还真有，龙族宝库的材料太齐全了，什么都有！”
那就兑换，石乐志没有半点犹豫，军功积分本来就是要依赖小军的法器，升级大地支柱是关系到下个季度积分冲榜的大事。
现在各族都开始养成自家的天道法器，其中难免也会有一些特殊能力的顶级属性，到时竞争压力会越来越大。
他们也要不断提升自己，才能保住高排名。
进展十分顺利，五天之后，在地下三十里处的地下空洞中，石小军完成了对棍子法器的化灵蜕变升级，整根棍子，彻底发生了形态变化。
除了从四尺多长，变为六尺长，粗细如手腕般大，整个棍身，材质已经完全改变，从灰土般的外形，变为晶莹如玉般透明，没有杂质，灵纹清晰如游龙盘旋，若隐若现如神龙隐藏，灵光内敛。
“收！”
他意念一动，齐眉的六尺长棍，迅速变化，如同一根水柱般，融入他的手掌，进入他的身体，一路流入到灵台神府，在他的元神前面停下。
他凝结没多久的小小元婴，伸手触碰这根显得有些巨大的棍子，随着他意识沉入其中，控制着法器变化，很快这棍子就缩小，与元婴的手臂刚好适配的程度。
小小人儿拿着趁手的小棍子，在神府中舞动起来。
各种棍法使将出来，神府中灵光闪动，气息流窜，逐渐形成一个独特的灵域。
“元神还是太小，发挥不出它的威力，不过这样锻炼，对元神成长有帮助。”
耍了一会棍法，他感觉与棍子之间的融合是越发的亲密，好像就是自己身体的一部分，停下来他展开大地领域，周围百里范围的一切动静，都仿佛全在自己眼皮底子下发生，一目了然，并且可以掌控。

“感应范围很大，但控制范围还是只有十余里。”
再远就好像力量无法传递过去，控制不住。
他把大地中的能量都汇聚过来，给元婴吸收，加快元神的成长。
content_en:
Shi Xiaojun took advantage of this short break to prepare to complete the last spiritual transformation for the Earth Pillar.
He searched for treasure deep underground for several days to gather materials to upgrade, but in the end he still couldn't find two materials. He had no choice but to return to the surface and look for Uncle Jiu.
Since you can't find it yourself, you can only buy it outside.
There are various trading websites in the Dragon World, both online and offline. The trading websites established by the Dragon Clan themselves are usually for direct transactions online and can be delivered by express delivery. There are also some private transactions where information is posted online and then traded offline. However, many of these are deceptive and it is easy to be deceived and lose money.
"Xiaojun, what materials are you missing to upgrade your magic weapon? Let me see if there are any of these materials in the Dragon Clan's treasure house. We happen to have three redemption rights."
The spiritual materials needed to transform spirits are of high quality. Even if the Dragon Clan has these materials, they will not be open to the public.
But Shi Jiajun, who won the quarterly points this time, had the right to redeem the top materials in the treasure house, which was just right for him to use, otherwise he would have had to buy them on the black market.
"It really does exist. The materials in the Dragon Clan's treasure house are too complete. They have everything!"
Then exchange it, Shi Lezhi didn't hesitate at all. Military merit points originally depended on Xiaojun's magic weapon. Upgrading the Earth Pillar was a major event related to the points ranking in the next quarter.
Now all races are beginning to develop their own heavenly magic weapons, which will inevitably have some special abilities and top-level attributes, and the pressure of competition will increase.
They must also continue to improve themselves in order to maintain high rankings.
The progress was very smooth. Five days later, in an underground cave thirty miles underground, Shi Xiaojun completed the transformation and upgrade of the stick's magical weapon. The entire stick completely changed its shape.
In addition to changing from more than four feet long to six feet long and as thick as a wrist, the material of the entire stick body has completely changed, from the appearance of dust to as transparent as jade, without impurities, the spiritual patterns are clear like a hovering dragon, looming like a hidden dragon, and the spiritual light is restrained.
"Take it!"
With a thought, the six-foot-long stick that reached his eyebrows quickly changed, blending into his palm like a water column, entering his body, flowing all the way to the Lingtai Divine Mansion, and stopping in front of his soul.
His little Nascent Soul, which had not long been condensed, reached out to touch the somewhat huge stick. As his consciousness sank into it and he controlled the changes of the magic weapon, the stick soon shrank to the point where it just fit the Nascent Soul's arm.
The little man held a handy little stick and started dancing in the God's Mansion.
Various stick magicians came out, the spiritual light flashed in the divine palace, and the breath flowed, gradually forming a unique spiritual realm.
"The soul is still too young to exert its power, but training like this will help the soul grow."
After playing with the stick for a while, he felt that the fusion with the stick was becoming more and more intimate, as if it was a part of his own body. When he stopped, he expanded the land area, and all the movements within a hundred miles around him seemed to be happening under his eyes, clearly visible and controllable.
"The sensing range is very large, but the control range is still only more than ten miles."
No matter how far away it is, it seems that the power cannot be transmitted and cannot be controlled.
He gathered all the energy in the earth and absorbed it for Yuanying to accelerate the growth of Yuanshen.
